description: This file defines internal structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes for WebSocket handling within the Zephyr project. It includes websocket context management, parser states, buffer descriptions, and functions for disconnecting and iterating over websocket contexts.

methods.name: websocket_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects a websocket connection given its socket ID.

methods.name: websocket_context_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all websocket contexts, invoking a callback for each.
